summary: Finance API Accounting Activities endpoints decommissioned
details:
On 2026-05-04 Xero decommissioned the Finance API's Accounting Activities API: Account Usage, Lock History, Report History and User Activities. All of these endpoints now return errors. Xero suggests the Bank Statements API for cash flow and financial analysis.

Remove calls to /finance.xro/1.0/AccountingActivities/AccountUsage, LockHistory, ReportHistory and UserActivities, along with the features built on them. For cash-flow or transaction analysis, move to the Finance API Bank Statements endpoint (/finance.xro/1.0/BankStatementsPlus/statements). Lock history and user activity data have no direct replacement.
